---
name: "OPSX: Archive Bug"
description: "Archive a resolved bug report from openspec/bugs/"
allowed-tools: Bash(ls:*), Bash(cat:*), Bash(grep:*), Bash(sed:*), Bash(date:*), Bash(mkdir:*), Bash(mv:*), Read

Archive a resolved bug in `openspec/bugs/`.

**This file is hand-written and is NOT generated by `openspec update`.** Its
siblings in `.claude/commands/opsx/` are generated and will be rewritten on a
CLI upgrade; this one will not.

**Input**: Optionally specify a bug name after `/opsx:archive-bug` (e.g.
`/opsx:archive-bug doe-fuel-type-not-recognised`). If omitted, infer it from
conversation context, auto-select when exactly one unarchived bug exists, and
otherwise prompt with the list.

Run the `openspec-archive-bug` skill for the selected bug and follow it exactly.
It reads `openspec/bugs/<name>/report.md` directly and never calls the OpenSpec
CLI, which knows only `openspec/changes/`.

Bugs are not changes. If the name resolves under `openspec/changes/` rather
than `openspec/bugs/`, stop and use `/opsx:archive` instead.
